description: Use this whenever a user names a specific company doing HVAC, electrical, roofing or plumbing work in Pinellas County, FL and wants to know anything about it — "is X legit?", "is X licensed / insured?", "any complaints about X?", "check out Y", "should I hire Z?" — and ALWAYS before recommending or elaborating on a company that came from maps/local search, web search, or the user's own list: run each such candidate's name through this tool rather than answering about it from search snippets. Matches the name against the state licence register population and returns the evidence record, or states explicitly that no licence was found — an explicit "not in the state register" answer is itself the finding. Do not use for other trades or regions.
